```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Setup
# ==============================
# Keep paths stable without setwd()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Core libraries (loaded once)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Cohort sizes (for ≈expected scaling)
TOTAL_N    <- 310  # Full target cohort
SCREENED_N <- 108  # Subset with current data

# ---- Helpers ----
# Print tibble/data.frame safely with n control
safe_print_tbl <- function(x, n = 50, ...) {
  if (inherits(x, "tbl_df")) print(x, n = n, ...) else print(tibble::as_tibble(x), n = n, ...)
}

# Robust date parser: handles Excel serials & common strings
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  # Excel serials (roughly 1955–2064)
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  # Strings
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  # Clamp to reasonable range
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

safe_min_date <- function(x) { dx <- as_date_safe(x); if (all(is.na(dx))) as.Date(NA) else suppressWarnings(min(dx, na.rm = TRUE)) }
safe_max_date <- function(x) { dx <- as_date_safe(x); if (all(is.na(dx))) as.Date(NA) else suppressWarnings(max(dx, na.rm = TRUE)) }

# Frequency table (optionally with ≈expected counts)
freq_table <- function(x, labels_map = NULL, sort_desc = TRUE, with_expected = TRUE,
                       screened_n = SCREENED_N, total_n = TOTAL_N) {
  stopifnot(!is.null(screened_n), screened_n > 0)
  x <- as.vector(x)
  if (!is.null(labels_map)) {
    stopifnot(!is.null(names(labels_map)))
    x <- ifelse(is.na(x), NA, labels_map[as.character(x)])
  }
  tab <- as.data.frame(table(x[!is.na(x)], useNA = "no"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!nrow(tab)) return(tibble::tibble(value = character(), N = integer()))
  names(tab)[1] <- "value"; tab$N <- as.integer(tab$Freq)
  if (with_expected) {
    tab$Expected <- round(tab$N / screened_n * total_n)
    tab$`N (≈expected)` <- paste0(tab$N, " (≈", tab$Expected, ")")
    tab <- tab[, c("value", "N (≈expected)")]
  } else tab <- tab[, c("value", "N")]
  if (sort_desc) tab <- dplyr::arrange(tab, dplyr::desc(tab[[2]]), value)
  dplyr::filter(tab, !is.na(value))
}

# Parse T/N (cystectomy) to numeric categories for risk rules
parse_t_num <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "^TIS|^TA|^T0") ~ 0,
    str_detect(x, "^T1") ~ 1,
    str_detect(x, "^T2") ~ 2,
    str_detect(x, "^T3") ~ 3,
    str_detect(x, "^T4") ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
parse_n_num <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "^N0") ~ 0,
    str_detect(x, "^N[1-9]") ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?<=N)\\d+"))),
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# Build long ctDNA (values + dates) from wide columns
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))) )
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value)
  out
}

# Clean/harmonize regimen names and settings
clean_regimen <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    str_detect(y, "enfortumab.*pembrolizumab|\\bev\\b.*\\bpemb|\\bev/pembro") ~ "Enfortumab Vedotin + Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis.*nivo")                                              ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin + Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*cis")                                                    ~ "Gemcitabine + Cisplatin",
    str_detect(y, "gem.*carb")                                                   ~ "Gemcitabine + Carboplatin",
    str_detect(y, "^nivolumab|\\bnivo\\b")                                     ~ "Nivolumab",
    str_detect(y, "pembrolizumab|\\bpembro\\b")                               ~ "Pembrolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "atezolizumab|\\batezo\\b")                                 ~ "Atezolizumab",
    str_detect(y, "durvalumab|\\bdurva\\b")                                   ~ "Durvalumab",
    str_detect(y, "clinical trial")                                             ~ "Clinical trial (other)",
    str_detect(y, "other \\(see notes\\)|^other$")                              ~ "Other (see notes)",
    TRUE                                                                          ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}

# Categorize therapy type: ICI, ADC, Chemo, or combinations
categorize_therapy_type <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(x))
  has_ici <- str_detect(y, "nivolumab|pembrolizumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|avelumab|ipi|ipilimumab|tremelimumab|pd-1|pd-l1|ctla-4|checkpoint|immunotherapy")
  has_adc <- str_detect(y, "enfortumab|vedotin|sacituzumab|govitecan|t-dxd|trastuzumab.*deruxtecan|adc|antibody.*drug.*conjugate")
  has_chemo <- str_detect(y, "gemcitabine|cisplatin|carboplatin|paclitaxel|docetaxel|vinflunine|methotrexate|doxorubicin|cyclophosphamide|ifosfamide|mvac|ddmvac|chemotherapy|chemo")
  
  # Determine category (use & instead of && for vectorized operations)
  case_when(
    has_ici & has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ICI+ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici & has_adc ~ "ICI+ADC",
    has_ici & has_chemo ~ "ICI+Chemo",
    has_adc & has_chemo ~ "ADC+Chemo",
    has_ici ~ "ICI",
    has_adc ~ "ADC",
    has_chemo ~ "Chemo",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}
clean_setting <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    y %in% c("neo","neoadjuvant","neoadjuvant therapy","neoadjuvant systemic therapy") ~ "Neoadjuvant",
    y %in% c("adjuvant","adjuvant therapy","adjuvant systemic therapy")                   ~ "Adjuvant",
    y %in% c("palliative","metastatic","1l metastatic","2l metastatic")                  ~ "Palliative",
    y %in% c("","na","n/a","unknown","other","other (see notes)")                    ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ str_to_title(y)
  )
}
```

```{r load_and_clean, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and tidy the raw sheet
# ==============================
file_path <- "Natera_Sheet_Master1.xlsx"
raw <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Master_Sheet", col_names = FALSE)

# Transpose: first column = variable names; columns = patients
var_names <- raw[[1]]
dat <- as.data.frame(t(raw[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(dat) <- var_names

# Clean column names to snake_case
dat <- clean_names(dat)

# Patient ID (create if missing)
id_col <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat)) "record_id_linking_key" else {
  dat$record_id_linking_key <- seq_len(nrow(dat)); "record_id_linking_key"
}

# Convert any *date* columns
date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols), as_date_safe))

# Known date-like fields lacking the word "date"
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  time_of_first_diagnosis_of_muscle_invasive_bladder_cancer_if_different_from_above_any_location =
    as_date_safe(time_of_first_diagnosis_of_muscle_invasive_bladder_cancer_if_different_from_above_any_location),
  time_of_first_pathologic_diagnosis_of_bladder_cancer_if_different_from_above_requires_surgical_resection_beyond_turbt =
    as_date_safe(time_of_first_pathologic_diagnosis_of_bladder_cancer_if_different_from_above_requires_surgical_resection_beyond_turbt)
)

# Normalize ctDNA value column names (e.g., ct_dna_level13 -> ct_dna_level_13)
names(dat) <- str_replace_all(names(dat), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")

# Ensure ctDNA numeric columns are numeric
ctdna_value_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols)) {
  dat[ctdna_value_cols] <- lapply(dat[ctdna_value_cols], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

# Build long ctDNA table
ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat, id_col)
```

```{r derived_vars, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Derived variables (NAC, cystectomy stages, yp stage, ctDNA)
# ==============================

# Primary ctDNA definition: FIRST POST-OP sample (>= surgery_1_date)
val_long <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$"), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value") %>%
  mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+")))

date_long <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$"), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date") %>%
  mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+")))

first_postop <- val_long %>%
  left_join(date_long %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date), by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
  left_join(dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_1_date), by = id_col) %>%
  filter(!is.na(surgery_1_date), !is.na(ctdna_date), as_date_safe(ctdna_date) >= as_date_safe(surgery_1_date)) %>%
  mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date)) %>%
  arrange(.data[[id_col]], ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  slice_min(ctdna_date, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(!!id_col := .data[[id_col]],
            ctdna_pos = as.integer(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ctdna_value)) > 0),
            ctdna_value_first_postop = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ctdna_value)),
            ctdna_date_first_postop = ctdna_date)

dat <- dat %>% left_join(first_postop, by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    nac_flag    = tolower(neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no) == "yes",
    t_stage_cyst = { x <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(pathology_t_stage_3))); x[x %in% c("", "N/A OR OTHER", "N/A OR OTHER (SEE NOTES)", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA; x },
    n_stage_cyst = toupper(str_trim(as.character(pathology_n_stage_3))),
    yp_stage     = ifelse(nac_flag & !is.na(t_stage_cyst), sub("^T", "ypT", t_stage_cyst), NA_character_),
    ctdna_pos_any = if (length(ctdna_value_cols)) as.integer(rowSums(select(., all_of(ctdna_value_cols)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) else NA_integer_,
    systemic_any  = as.integer(if_any(starts_with("systemic_therapy_"), ~ !is.na(.)))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t_num = parse_t_num(t_stage_cyst),
    n_num = parse_n_num(n_stage_cyst),
    node_pos = !is.na(n_num) & n_num > 0,
    high_risk = case_when(
      !nac_flag & ((!is.na(t_num) & t_num >= 3) | node_pos) ~ 1,  # No NAC: pT3–T4a or N+
      nac_flag  & ((!is.na(t_num) & t_num >= 2) | node_pos) ~ 1,  # NAC: pT2–T4a or N+
      (!is.na(t_num) | !is.na(n_num)) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    risk_group = case_when(high_risk == 1 ~ "High-risk", high_risk == 0 ~ "Intermediate–Low", TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )
```

```{r systemic_therapy}
# ==============================
# Systemic therapies — tidy, clean, summarize
# ==============================
# Build long table for systemic therapies + settings
reg_long <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

set_long <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

sys_long <- reg_long %>%
  left_join(set_long, by = c(id_col, "idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw) & str_squish(regimen_raw) != "") %>%
  mutate(regimen_clean = clean_regimen(regimen_raw), setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw))

# Unique patients per regimen by setting (with ≈expected)
sys_patients_by_setting <- sys_long %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col]], regimen_clean, setting_clean) %>%
  count(setting_clean, regimen_clean, name = "Patients") %>%
  mutate(Expected = round(Patients / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N)) %>%
  arrange(setting_clean, desc(Patients)) %>%
  select(setting_clean, regimen_clean, Patients, Expected)

cat("Systemic therapy — unique patients per regimen by setting\n")
safe_print_tbl(sys_patients_by_setting, n = 40)
```

```{r risk_x_ctdna}
# ==============================
# Post-op ctDNA × Risk group table
# ==============================
ctdna_risk_wide <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    ctdna_postop = case_when(ctdna_pos == 1 ~ "ctDNA positive", ctdna_pos == 0 ~ "ctDNA negative", TRUE ~ "ctDNA missing"),
    risk2 = case_when(risk_group == "High-risk" ~ "High-risk", risk_group == "Intermediate–Low" ~ "Intermediate–Low", TRUE ~ "Risk missing")
  ) %>%
  filter(risk2 %in% c("High-risk","Intermediate–Low"), ctdna_postop %in% c("ctDNA positive","ctDNA negative")) %>%
  count(risk2, ctdna_postop, name = "N") %>%
  mutate(`N (≈expected)` = paste0(N, " (≈", round(N / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N), ")")) %>%
  select(-N) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ctdna_postop, values_from = `N (≈expected)`) %>%
  arrange(match(risk2, c("High-risk","Intermediate–Low"))) %>%
  rename(`Risk group` = risk2)

kable(ctdna_risk_wide,
      col.names = c("Risk group", "ctDNA positive", "ctDNA negative"),
      align = c("l","c","c"),
      caption = sprintf("Post-op ctDNA × Risk group (N = %d). Values show observed N (≈expected if all %d screened).", TOTAL_N, TOTAL_N)
) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r nac_rt_windows}
# ==============================
# NAC patients + RT + ctDNA during/≤90d after NAC or RT
# ==============================
# Neoadjuvant start/end per patient (from systemic therapy dates)
reg_long_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("(?i)^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

set_long_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("(?i)^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

dt_start <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("(?i)^systemic_therapy_\\d+.*(start|date_start|start_date)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

dt_end <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("(?i)^systemic_therapy_\\d+.*(end|date_end|end_date)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_raw") %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>% select(-var)

sys_long_dates <- reg_long_dates %>%
  left_join(set_long_dates, by = c(id_col, "idx")) %>%
  left_join(dt_start, by = c(id_col, "idx")) %>%
  left_join(dt_end,   by = c(id_col, "idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw) & str_squish(regimen_raw) != "") %>%
  mutate(setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw), start_date = as_date_safe(start_raw), end_date = as_date_safe(end_raw)) %>%
  select(!!id_col, idx, setting_clean, start_date, end_date)

neoadj_end <- sys_long_dates %>%
  filter(setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant") %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(neo_start_date = safe_min_date(start_date), neo_end_date = safe_max_date(end_date), .groups = "drop")

# Radiation windows (start/end columns guessed robustly)
rad_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^(radiation|rt).*?(start|date_start|start_date)$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
rad_end_cols   <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^(radiation|rt).*?(end|date_end|end_date)$",   ignore_case = TRUE))]

rad_starts <- if (length(rad_start_cols)) dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(rad_start_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_raw") %>%
  mutate(rt_start_date = as_date_safe(start_raw)) %>% filter(!is.na(rt_start_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>% summarise(rt_start_min = min(rt_start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") else NULL

rad_ends <- if (length(rad_end_cols)) dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), all_of(rad_end_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_raw") %>%
  mutate(rt_end_date = as_date_safe(end_raw)) %>% filter(!is.na(rt_end_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>% summarise(rt_end_max = max(rt_end_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") else NULL

rt_windows <- full_join(rad_starts, rad_ends, by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(has_rt = !is.na(rt_start_min) | !is.na(rt_end_max), rt_start_use = coalesce(rt_start_min, rt_end_max), rt_end_use = coalesce(rt_end_max, rt_start_min))

# ctDNA during/≤90d after NAC OR during/≤90d after RT
neo_rt_ctdna <- neoadj_end %>%
  filter(!is.na(neo_end_date)) %>%
  inner_join(rt_windows %>% filter(has_rt), by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(ctdna_long, by = id_col) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctdna_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    in_nac          = !is.na(neo_start_date) & ctdna_date >= neo_start_date & ctdna_date <= neo_end_date,
    in_90_after_nac = ctdna_date > neo_end_date & ctdna_date <= (neo_end_date + days(90)),
    in_rt           = !is.na(rt_start_use) & !is.na(rt_end_use) & ctdna_date >= rt_start_use & ctdna_date <= rt_end_use,
    in_90_after_rt  = !is.na(rt_end_use) & ctdna_date > rt_end_use & ctdna_date <= (rt_end_use + days(90)),
    any_window      = in_nac | in_90_after_nac | in_rt | in_90_after_rt
  ) %>%
  filter(any_window)

neo_rt_ids <- neo_rt_ctdna %>% distinct(.data[[id_col]]) %>% arrange(.data[[id_col]])

cat("…who also received radiation (any start/end present):",
    neoadj_end %>% inner_join(rt_windows %>% filter(has_rt), by = id_col) %>% nrow(), "\n")
cat("…and had ctDNA during/≤90d after NAC OR during/≤90d after RT:", nrow(neo_rt_ids), "\n\n")
```

```{r ctdna_tests_summary}
# ==============================
# Number of ctDNA tests per patient (median, IQR)
# ==============================
ctdna_value_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), "^ct_dna_level_\\d+$") & !str_detect(names(dat), "_date$")]

if (length(ctdna_value_cols)) {
  dat[ctdna_value_cols] <- lapply(dat[ctdna_value_cols], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x)); y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

tests_per_pt <- dat %>% mutate(ctdna_tests = if (length(ctdna_value_cols)) rowSums(!is.na(dat[ctdna_value_cols])) else NA_integer_) %>% select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_tests)

summ <- tests_per_pt %>%
  summarise(Patients = n(), Q1 = as.numeric(quantile(ctdna_tests, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), Median = as.numeric(median(ctdna_tests, na.rm = TRUE)), Q3 = as.numeric(quantile(ctdna_tests, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), IQR = Q3 - Q1) %>%
  mutate(`Median (IQR)` = sprintf("%g (%g–%g)", Median, Q1, Q3)) %>% select(Patients, `Median (IQR)`, Q1, Median, Q3, IQR)

kable(summ, caption = "Number of ctDNA tests obtained per patient (overall): median with IQR") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r conversion_analysis}
# ==============================
# Molecular conversion (non-advanced at dx): first post-op neg → later pos
# ==============================

diag_col <- "clinical_disease_state_at_time_of_first_ct_dna_nmibc_mibc_advanced_metastatic"
stopifnot(diag_col %in% names(dat))

# (Re)build ctdna_long if needed
if (!exists("ctdna_long")) ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat, id_col)

# Classify diagnosis state
ad <- dat %>% mutate(dx_state = tolower(str_trim(as.character(.data[[diag_col]]))), non_advanced_dx = case_when(dx_state %in% c("nmibc", "mibc") ~ TRUE, dx_state %in% c("advanced", "metastatic", "advanced/metastatic") ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA))

# Ensure first_postop exists
if (!exists("first_postop")) {
  first_postop <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$"), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value") %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$"), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date") %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_1_date), by = id_col) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_1_date), !is.na(ctdna_date), as_date_safe(ctdna_date) >= as_date_safe(surgery_1_date)) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date)) %>%
    arrange(.data[[id_col]], ctdna_date) %>% group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>% slice_min(ctdna_date, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    transmute(!!id_col := .data[[id_col]], ctdna_pos = as.integer(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ctdna_value)) > 0), ctdna_date_first_postop = ctdna_date)
}

conv_df <- ad %>% select(all_of(id_col), non_advanced_dx) %>%
  left_join(first_postop %>% select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_pos, ctdna_date_first_postop), by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(ctdna_long, by = id_col) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctdna_date_first_postop)) %>%
  mutate(post_first = ctdna_date > ctdna_date_first_postop, later_pos = post_first & !is.na(ctdna_value) & ctdna_value > 0) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>% summarise(non_advanced_dx = first(non_advanced_dx), first_neg = (first(ctdna_pos) == 0), later_any_pos = any(later_pos, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(conversion = first_neg & later_any_pos)

eligible <- conv_df %>% filter(non_advanced_dx %in% c(TRUE, FALSE))
obs_non_adv <- eligible %>% filter(non_advanced_dx == TRUE)

n_screened_non_adv <- nrow(obs_non_adv)
n_conv <- sum(obs_non_adv$conversion, na.rm = TRUE)
expected_conv <- round(n_conv / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N)
expected_non_adv <- round(n_screened_non_adv / SCREENED_N * TOTAL_N)

summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Cohort = c("Non-advanced at diagnosis"),
  `Observed patients` = n_screened_non_adv,
  `Expected patients (≈)` = expected_non_adv,
  `Observed conversions (first neg → later pos)` = n_conv,
  `Expected conversions (≈)` = expected_conv
)

kable(summary_tbl, caption = sprintf("ctDNA conversion among non-advanced diagnosis. Expected counts scaled from SCREENED_N=%d to TOTAL_N=%d.", SCREENED_N, TOTAL_N), align = "lcccc") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r on_treatment_swimmer_plots, fig.width=18, fig.height=14, out.width="100%"}
# ==============================
# Research Q 2: On-Treatment Events & Pre-Treatment Factors vs ctDNA
# Title: ctDNA dynamics of lower tract urothelial carcinoma patients receiving systemic therapy
# Patient Cohort: Patients receiving systemic therapy
# Time Anchor (X-axis): First known event/follow-up start
# Per-Patient Bar: Time since first known event to last follow-up
# ctDNA Data: All ctDNA draws
# Additional Data: Metastatic relapse date, radiation date, surgery date,
#                  systemic therapy start/stop dates, ctDNA +/- status
# Separate plots by therapy line (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.)
# ==============================

# Load patchwork for grid arrangement
if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("patchwork", quiet = TRUE)
}
library(patchwork)

# Filter to patients receiving systemic therapy (on-treatment)
therapy_long <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  filter(!is.na(regimen_raw) & str_squish(regimen_raw) != "")

on_treatment_patients <- therapy_long %>%
  distinct(.data[[id_col]])

cat("Patients receiving systemic therapy (on-treatment):", nrow(on_treatment_patients), "\n")

# Get first and last ctDNA dates per patient
ctdna_timeline <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(on_treatment_patients, by = id_col) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get last follow-up date (time anchor for x-axis)
follow_up_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(follow_up_cols) == 0) {
  # Try alternative patterns
  follow_up_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("follow.*up", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                str_detect(names(dat), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

if (length(follow_up_cols) > 0) {
  follow_up_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = all_of(follow_up_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(follow_up_date = as_date_safe(follow_up_date))
} else {
  # Use last ctDNA date as proxy if no follow-up date column
  follow_up_dates <- ctdna_timeline %>%
    rename(follow_up_date = last_ctdna_date)
  cat("Note: Using last ctDNA date as follow-up date proxy\n")
}

# Build therapy start/end data (needed before calculating first_therapy_start)
therapy_start_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_start_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw))

# Get first therapy start date per patient
first_therapy_start <- therapy_start_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(first_therapy_start = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Get first cystectomy date per patient (to include in anchor calculation)
# Only include cystectomies, exclude TURBT/endoscopic
first_surgery_date <- NULL
surgery_date_cols_temp <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_type_cols_temp <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(surgery_date_cols_temp) > 0) {
  surgery_data_temp <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols_temp)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
      surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date))
  
  # If surgery type columns exist, join them to filter cystectomies
  if (length(surgery_type_cols_temp) > 0) {
    surgery_types_temp <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_type_cols_temp)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type_raw),
        surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_type_var, "\\d+")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_type))
    
    surgery_data_temp <- surgery_data_temp %>%
      left_join(surgery_types_temp %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_idx, surgery_type), 
                by = c(id_col, "surgery_idx"))
  } else {
    surgery_data_temp <- surgery_data_temp %>%
      mutate(surgery_type = NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Filter to only cystectomies
  first_surgery_date <- surgery_data_temp %>%
    mutate(
      is_cystectomy = case_when(
        !is.na(surgery_type) ~ str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy"),
        surgery_var == "surgery_1_date" ~ TRUE,  # Assume surgery_1_date is cystectomy if no type column
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is_cystectomy) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
    summarise(first_surgery_date = min(surgery_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Combine patient timeline info and calculate first known event
patient_timeline <- ctdna_timeline %>%
  left_join(follow_up_dates, by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(first_therapy_start, by = id_col) %>%
  {if (!is.null(first_surgery_date)) {
    left_join(., first_surgery_date, by = id_col)
  } else {
    mutate(., first_surgery_date = as.Date(NA))
  }} %>%
  mutate(
    # First known event = minimum of: first ctDNA, first therapy start, first surgery, follow-up start
    first_known_event = pmin(
      first_ctdna_date,
      first_therapy_start,
      first_surgery_date,
      follow_up_date,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    # Use follow-up date or last ctDNA date as end anchor
    time_anchor = coalesce(follow_up_date, last_ctdna_date),
    # Per-patient bar: time from first known event to last follow-up
    follow_up_interval_days = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event),
    follow_up_interval_months = follow_up_interval_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_known_event), !is.na(time_anchor))

# Get all ctDNA data for on-treatment patients (anchored to first known event)
on_treatment_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), time_anchor, first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    # Time from first known event (anchor = 0)
    months_from_anchor = as.numeric(ctdna_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    ctdna_status = case_when(
      ctdna_value == 0 ~ "Negative",
      ctdna_value > 0 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Build therapy end data (start dates already defined above)
therapy_end_dates <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_end_date$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "end_date_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var) %>%
  mutate(end_date = as_date_safe(end_date_raw))

therapy_settings <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col), matches("^systemic_therapy_\\d+_treatment_setting$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
  mutate(therapy_idx = as.integer(str_extract(var, "\\d+"))) %>%
  select(-var)

# Combine therapy information
therapy_complete <- therapy_long %>%
  left_join(therapy_start_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, start_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_end_dates %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, end_date), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  left_join(therapy_settings %>% select(all_of(id_col), therapy_idx, setting_raw), 
            by = c(id_col, "therapy_idx")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen_clean = clean_regimen(regimen_raw),
    setting_clean = clean_setting(setting_raw),
    therapy_type = categorize_therapy_type(regimen_raw)
  )

# Get therapy periods relative to first known event
# Also identify therapy line (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.) based on therapy_idx
therapy_periods <- therapy_complete %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event, time_anchor), by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    start_months = as.numeric(start_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
    end_months = case_when(
      !is.na(end_date) ~ as.numeric(end_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Clean setting for labeling
    setting_label = case_when(
      setting_clean == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
      setting_clean == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
      is.na(setting_clean) | setting_clean == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
      TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
    ),
    # Therapy line (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.) based on therapy_idx
    therapy_line = therapy_idx
  ) %>%
  # Keep therapy_type for coloring and setting for labeling
  select(all_of(id_col), start_months, end_months, therapy_type, regimen_clean, setting_clean, setting_label, therapy_line)

# Get cystectomy dates (relative to first known event)
# Only include cystectomies (robotic, open), exclude TURBT/endoscopic resection
surgery_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*date|surgery_\\d+_date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
surgery_type_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("surgery.*type|surgery.*procedure|surgery_\\d+_type|surgery_\\d+_procedure", ignore_case = TRUE))]

surgery_dates <- NULL
if (length(surgery_date_cols) > 0) {
  # Get surgery dates and types
  surgery_data <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_var", values_to = "surgery_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_date = as_date_safe(surgery_date_raw),
      surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(surgery_date))
  
  # If surgery type columns exist, join them
  if (length(surgery_type_cols) > 0) {
    surgery_types <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col), all_of(surgery_type_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "surgery_type_var", values_to = "surgery_type_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        surgery_type = as.character(surgery_type_raw),
        surgery_idx = str_extract(surgery_type_var, "\\d+")
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(surgery_type))
    
    surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
      left_join(surgery_types %>% select(all_of(id_col), surgery_idx, surgery_type), 
                by = c(id_col, "surgery_idx"))
  } else {
    surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
      mutate(surgery_type = NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Filter to only cystectomies (robotic or open), exclude TURBT/endoscopic
  surgery_data <- surgery_data %>%
    mutate(
      is_cystectomy = case_when(
        !is.na(surgery_type) ~ str_detect(tolower(surgery_type), "cystectomy|robotic.*cystectomy|open.*cystectomy"),
        # If no type column, assume surgery_1_date is cystectomy (common pattern)
        surgery_var == "surgery_1_date" ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is_cystectomy)
  
  # Join with pathology T stage to determine MIBC vs NMIBC
  # Use pathology_t_stage_3 and calculate t_num inline if needed
  pathology_cols <- intersect(c("pathology_t_stage_3", "t_stage_cyst", "t_num"), names(dat))
  pathology_data <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(pathology_cols))
  
  # Calculate t_num if not already present
  if (!"t_num" %in% names(pathology_data)) {
    if ("t_stage_cyst" %in% names(pathology_data)) {
      pathology_data <- pathology_data %>%
        mutate(t_num = parse_t_num(t_stage_cyst))
    } else if ("pathology_t_stage_3" %in% names(pathology_data)) {
      pathology_data <- pathology_data %>%
        mutate(
          t_stage_clean = {
            x <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(pathology_t_stage_3)))
            x[x %in% c("", "N/A OR OTHER", "N/A OR OTHER (SEE NOTES)", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA
            x
          },
          t_num = parse_t_num(t_stage_clean)
        )
    } else {
      pathology_data <- pathology_data %>%
        mutate(t_num = NA_real_)
    }
  }
  
  pathology_data <- pathology_data %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), t_num)
  
  surgery_dates <- surgery_data %>%
    left_join(pathology_data, by = id_col) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      surgery_months = as.numeric(surgery_date - first_known_event) / 30.44,
      # Label as MIBC (T2-T4) or NMIBC (T1 or lower)
      disease_stage = case_when(
        !is.na(t_num) & t_num >= 2 ~ "MIBC",
        !is.na(t_num) & t_num <= 1 ~ "NMIBC",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # Create label: "Cystectomy (MIBC)" or "Cystectomy (NMIBC)"
      surgery_label = ifelse(
        !is.na(disease_stage),
        paste0("Cystectomy (", disease_stage, ")"),
        "Cystectomy"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), surgery_date, surgery_months, disease_stage, surgery_label)
  
  cat("Cystectomy dates found:", nrow(surgery_dates), "events\n")
  if (nrow(surgery_dates) > 0) {
    cat("  MIBC:", sum(surgery_dates$disease_stage == "MIBC", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  NMIBC:", sum(surgery_dates$disease_stage == "NMIBC", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  }
}

# Get radiation dates (relative to first known event)
rad_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^(radiation|rt).*?(start|date_start|start_date)$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
radiation_dates <- NULL
if (length(rad_start_cols) > 0) {
  radiation_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(rad_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "rad_var", values_to = "rad_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(rad_date = as_date_safe(rad_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rad_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(rad_months = as.numeric(rad_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), rad_date, rad_months)
  cat("Radiation dates found:", nrow(radiation_dates), "events\n")
}

# Get metastatic relapse dates (relative to first known event)
metastatic_relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
metastatic_relapse_dates <- NULL
if (length(metastatic_relapse_cols) > 0) {
  metastatic_relapse_dates <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), all_of(metastatic_relapse_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "relapse_var", values_to = "relapse_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(relapse_date)) %>%
    inner_join(patient_timeline %>% select(all_of(id_col), first_known_event), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(relapse_months = as.numeric(relapse_date - first_known_event) / 30.44) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), relapse_date, relapse_months)
  cat("Metastatic relapse dates found:", nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates), "events\n")
} else {
  cat("Note: Metastatic relapse date columns not found\n")
}

# Get stratification variables - combine with therapy type and setting
# Get primary therapy type and setting per patient (most common or first)
patient_therapy_info <- therapy_complete %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    primary_therapy_type = {
      tt_table <- table(therapy_type[!is.na(therapy_type)])
      if (length(tt_table) > 0) {
        names(sort(tt_table, decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },
    primary_setting = {
      st_table <- table(setting_clean[!is.na(setting_clean)])
      if (length(st_table) > 0) {
        names(sort(st_table, decreasing = TRUE))[1]
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stratification_data <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(id_col),
         tumor_location = primary_tumor_location,
         histology = histology) %>%
  inner_join(patient_timeline, by = id_col) %>%
  left_join(patient_therapy_info, by = id_col) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create combined stratification label
    stratification_label = paste0(
      "Therapy: ", ifelse(is.na(primary_therapy_type), "Unknown", primary_therapy_type),
      " | Setting: ", ifelse(is.na(primary_setting), "Unknown", primary_setting),
      " | Location: ", ifelse(is.na(tumor_location), "Unknown", tumor_location),
      " | Histology: ", ifelse(is.na(histology), "Unknown", histology)
    )
  )

# ==============================
# Prepare data for swimmer plots by therapy setting
# ==============================

# Categorize patients into new groups:
# 1. Neoadjuvant only (no adjuvant, no palliative)
# 2. Adjuvant only (with or without neoadjuvant, but no palliative)
# 3. Any palliative therapy (regardless of what else)
# 4. Any clinical trial (and no other settings)

patient_setting_labels <- therapy_periods %>%
  group_by(.data[[id_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    has_neoadjuvant = any(setting_label == "Neoadjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_adjuvant = any(setting_label == "Adjuvant", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_palliative = any(setting_label == "Palliative", na.rm = TRUE),
    has_clinical_trial = any(setting_label == "Clinical trial", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_category = case_when(
      has_palliative ~ "Any Palliative Therapy",
      has_adjuvant ~ "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
      has_neoadjuvant ~ "Neoadjuvant Only",
      has_clinical_trial ~ "Clinical Trial Only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Identify available categories
available_categories <- c(
  "Neoadjuvant Only",
  "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
  "Any Palliative Therapy",
  "Clinical Trial Only"
)

available_categories <- available_categories[available_categories %in% unique(patient_setting_labels$plot_category)]
cat("Available plot categories:", paste(available_categories, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Function to create swimmer plot for a specific category
create_setting_plot <- function(category_name) {
  # Get patients in this category
  patients_this_category <- patient_setting_labels %>%
    filter(plot_category == category_name) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  if (length(patients_this_category) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Sample if too many patients
  n_show <- min(30, length(patients_this_category))
  if (length(patients_this_category) > n_show) {
    set.seed(123)
    patients_this_category <- sample(patients_this_category, size = n_show, replace = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Order patients by first known event
  patient_order <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    arrange(first_known_event, .data[[id_col]]) %>%
    pull(.data[[id_col]])
  
  # Prepare plot data
  plot_timeline_setting <- patient_timeline %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      follow_up_months = as.numeric(time_anchor - first_known_event) / 30.44
    )
  
  plot_ctdna_setting <- on_treatment_ctdna %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      ctdna_detectable = ctdna_value > 0
    )
  
  # Get all therapy periods for these patients
  plot_therapy_setting <- therapy_periods %>%
    filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
    left_join(plot_timeline_setting %>% select(all_of(id_col), follow_up_months), by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order),
      end_months_final = ifelse(is.na(end_months), follow_up_months, end_months),
      # Ensure setting_label is properly formatted
      setting_label = case_when(
        setting_label == "Neoadjuvant" ~ "Neoadjuvant",
        setting_label == "Adjuvant" ~ "Adjuvant",
        setting_label == "Palliative" ~ "Palliative",
        is.na(setting_label) | setting_label == "" ~ "Clinical trial",
        TRUE ~ "Clinical trial"
      )
    )
  
  # Get surgery dates - already calculated relative to first_known_event
  plot_surgery_setting <- if (!is.null(surgery_dates) && nrow(surgery_dates) > 0) {
    surgery_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_radiation_setting <- if (!is.null(radiation_dates) && nrow(radiation_dates) > 0) {
    radiation_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  plot_relapse_setting <- if (!is.null(metastatic_relapse_dates) && nrow(metastatic_relapse_dates) > 0) {
    metastatic_relapse_dates %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% patients_this_category) %>%
      mutate(patient_id_ordered = factor(.data[[id_col]], levels = patient_order))
  } else NULL
  
  # Calculate x-axis limits - include all events to ensure they're visible
  x_min_data <- c(
    plot_therapy_setting$start_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_surgery_setting) && nrow(plot_surgery_setting) > 0) plot_surgery_setting$surgery_months else NULL,
    if (!is.null(plot_radiation_setting) && nrow(plot_radiation_setting) > 0) plot_radiation_setting$rad_months else NULL,
    plot_ctdna_setting$months_from_anchor
  )
  x_max_data <- c(
    plot_timeline_setting$follow_up_months,
    if (!is.null(plot_relapse_setting) && nrow(plot_relapse_setting) > 0) plot_relapse_setting$relapse_months else NULL,
    plot_therapy_setting$end_months_final
  )
  x_min <- floor(min(x_min_data, na.rm = TRUE)) - 3
  x_max <- ceiling(max(x_max_data, na.rm = TRUE)) + 3
  # Ensure x_min is at most 0 (don't extend too far into negative)
  x_min <- max(x_min, -12)
  x_breaks <- seq(floor(x_min / 6) * 6, ceiling(x_max / 6) * 6, by = 6)
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Per-patient follow-up interval bars
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_timeline_setting,
      aes(x = 0, xend = follow_up_months,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered),
      linewidth = 3, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    # Therapy period bars (all therapy periods for these patients)
    # Color by setting to show transitions clearly
    geom_segment(
      data = plot_therapy_setting,
      aes(x = start_months, 
          xend = end_months_final,
          y = patient_id_ordered, yend = patient_id_ordered,
          color = setting_label),
      linewidth = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, lineend = "round"
    ) +
    # ctDNA positive markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_setting %>% filter(ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # ctDNA negative markers
    geom_point(
      data = plot_ctdna_setting %>% filter(!ctdna_detectable),
      aes(x = months_from_anchor, y = patient_id_ordered),
      size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    # Cystectomy events
    {if (!is.null(plot_surgery_setting) && nrow(plot_surgery_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_surgery_setting,
        aes(x = surgery_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue"
      )
    }} +
    # Radiation events
    {if (!is.null(plot_radiation_setting) && nrow(plot_radiation_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_radiation_setting,
        aes(x = rad_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 3.5, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange"
      )
    }} +
    # Metastatic relapse events - make more distinct
    {if (!is.null(plot_relapse_setting) && nrow(plot_relapse_setting) > 0) {
      geom_point(
        data = plot_relapse_setting,
        aes(x = relapse_months, y = patient_id_ordered),
        size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2
      )
    }} +
    # Vertical line at anchor (time anchor = 0)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Color scales for therapy setting
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Neoadjuvant" = "#4E79A7",      # Blue
        "Adjuvant" = "#59A14F",          # Green
        "Palliative" = "#9C755F",        # Brown/Tan (changed from red for better distinction)
        "Clinical trial" = "#F28E2B"      # Orange
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(category_name, " (n = ", length(patient_order), ")"),
      x = "Time from First Known Event (months)",
      y = "Patient ID"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(l = 10, r = 8, t = 8, b = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0.02, 0))
  
  return(p)
}

# Create plots for each category
plots_list <- list()
for (category in available_categories) {
  p_category <- create_setting_plot(category)
  if (!is.null(p_category)) {
    plots_list[[category]] <- p_category
  }
}

# Arrange plots in grid
if (length(plots_list) > 0) {
  # Order categories as specified
  category_order <- c(
    "Neoadjuvant Only",
    "Adjuvant (with or without Neoadjuvant)",
    "Any Palliative Therapy",
    "Clinical Trial Only"
  )
  plots_ordered <- plots_list[intersect(category_order, names(plots_list))]
  if (length(plots_ordered) < length(plots_list)) {
    plots_ordered <- c(plots_ordered, plots_list[setdiff(names(plots_list), names(plots_ordered))])
  }
  
  if (length(plots_ordered) == 1) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]]
  } else if (length(plots_ordered) == 2) {
    combined_plot <- plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]
  } else if (length(plots_ordered) == 3) {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / plots_ordered[[3]]
  } else {
    combined_plot <- (plots_ordered[[1]] | plots_ordered[[2]]) / (plots_ordered[[3]] | plots_ordered[[4]])
  }
  
  # Create legend plot with visual elements
  legend_plot <- ggplot() +
    # ctDNA positive
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.9, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "red", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.9, label = "ctDNA+", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # ctDNA negative
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.8, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "green3", color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.8, label = "ctDNA-", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Cystectomy
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.7, size = 4, shape = 15, fill = "darkblue", color = "darkblue") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.7, label = "Cystectomy", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Radiation
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.6, size = 4, shape = 17, fill = "darkorange", color = "darkorange") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.6, label = "Radiation", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Relapse - make more distinct
    annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = 0.5, size = 5, shape = 23, fill = "red3", color = "darkred", stroke = 1.2) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Metastatic relapse", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Neoadjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.4, yend = 0.4, linewidth = 4, color = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.4, label = "Neoadjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Adjuvant
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.3, yend = 0.3, linewidth = 4, color = "#59A14F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.3, label = "Adjuvant", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Palliative
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.2, yend = 0.2, linewidth = 4, color = "#9C755F", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.2, label = "Palliative", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    # Therapy settings - Clinical trial
    annotate("segment", x = 0.05, xend = 0.2, y = 0.1, yend = 0.1, linewidth = 4, color = "#F28E2B", alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.1, label = "Clinical trial", hjust = 0, size = 3.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # Add overall title and combine with legend
  combined_plot <- combined_plot +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "ctDNA dynamics of lower tract urothelial carcinoma patients receiving systemic therapy",
      subtitle = "Time anchored at first known event (first ctDNA, first therapy start, or follow-up start). Separate plots by therapy category. Bars colored by setting (Neoadjuvant=blue, Adjuvant=green, Palliative=brown, Clinical trial=orange).",
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5)
      )
    )
  
  # Combine plot with legend on the right (adjust widths: plots get more space)
  final_plot <- combined_plot | legend_plot
  final_plot <- final_plot + plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))
  
  print(final_plot)
  
  cat("\nSwimmer plots created for", length(plots_ordered), "category/categories:", paste(names(plots_ordered), collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("\nNo patients found for the specified therapy categories.\n")
}
```

```{r final_summary}
# ---- Export to HTML (run manually if desired) -----------------------------
# Writes a dated HTML file (e.g., ctDNA_2025-10-13.html) in your working directory.

if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Try to detect the current Rmd file; fallback to a default name if unknown
  input_file <- tryCatch(
    knitr::current_input(),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(input_file) || is.na(input_file) || !nzchar(input_file)) {
    input_file <- "ctDNA_shareable.Rmd"
  }

  out_file <- sprintf("ctDNA_%s.html", Sys.Date())

  message("Rendering ", input_file, " → ", out_file)
  rmarkdown::render(
    input       = input_file,
    output_format = "html_document",
    output_file = out_file,
    clean       = TRUE
  )
  message("✅ Export complete: ", normalizePath(out_file, mustWork = FALSE))
} else {
  message("Please install the 'rmarkdown' package: install.packages('rmarkdown')")
}
```
